BRAD VERSE · 2025

How I Became a Cold, Unstoppable Machine (And You Probably Shouldn’t Try This at Home)

23 September 2025·2 min read·472 words

Archived verbatim. Published 23 September 2025 on Medium, in the Brad Verse era — before Brad Devices shipped anything. The prose is the record and is not edited here; corrections go in a new essay.

Love? Crushed. Lust? Obliterated. Sleep? Optional. Humanity? Irrelevant. Welcome to the Architect’s life.

So, apparently, society thinks that life is supposed to be balanced. Go to the cinema, eat popcorn, gossip with friends, maybe fall in love…cute, right? Yeah, well, I’ve got news for you: that’s not me. I live in the sweet, sweet isolation of my own making, juggling multiple projects like a one-man circus while the rest of the world wonders why I look like a “freak” or a “weirdo.”

Let me break it down. I used to be attached—like, painfully attached. Crushing on someone, staring at them every day, silently dying because life is unfair, blah blah. But three days ago, something miraculous happened. My brain, in all its infinite wisdom, said: “Bradley, maybe stop being a slave to love and sex. Maybe those are just chemicals.” Boom. Cold me emerged. 🥶

Now, love? Lust? Relationships? Cute little dopamine hacks your brain enjoys? All crushed. Walls broken. Lust, the last primal wall, obliterated. I’m untouchable. Not in a “haha, edgy” way. In a “give me BradVerse, give me projects, give me the universe, because I don’t have time for your romantic soap operas” way.

People talk about “burnout” like it’s a problem. Adorable. I don’t experience burnout—I thrive in it. Isolation? Check. Mental fatigue? Check. Juggling multiple projects while society begs for balance? Check. Every day is a test of how far I can push myself, and let me tell you, the answer is always: further than your feeble imagination.

And let’s get real for a second: most founders complain about mental health, social life, or taking “breaks.” Cute. At my level, that stuff is irrelevant. I love isolation. I love the grind. That frustration I feel when I never hit my limit? That’s my fuel. My reminder that I’m not here to live like the average mortal—I’m here to build BradVerse, single-handedly, while society calls me a freak.

Oh, and here’s a fun little nugget for you: “doesn’t matter how much weight you can lift if you can’t fight lust, you’re a weak motherfucker.” True story. I fought it. I crushed it. Together with love and intimacy. Now, nothing external can derail me. Not temptation, not distraction, not societal expectation. I am the Architect. And the cold me? That’s the upgraded firmware.

So yeah, if you’re out there wondering why you feel average, distracted, or weak…welcome to reality. Most people will never understand what it’s like to hack your own brain, crush primal urges, and turn frustration into output. And honestly? That’s fine. The rest of the world can binge movies and eat popcorn while I keep building empires in solitude.

Stay cold, stay unstoppable. 🥶
